# stb_image

`stb_image.h` is copied unchanged from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) at commit `4e9b368bfc071e97206ea5c6adba68dd0cbf8897` (stb_image v2.30). Its licence (MIT or public domain, your choice) is at the end of the file.

One header, so it's copied rather than added as a submodule, like RenderDoc's header (owner-approved). Only `Meow2Engine/src/Assets/Texture/StbImage.cpp` compiles its implementation, in its own library outside the engine's warnings.

To update it, copy the file from a newer commit and change the commit above.
